Professional Learning Labs for Educators

Professional Learning Lab: Abrac-ADAPTATION: Summoning Spellbinding Stories

Experiment with devising, playwriting and adaptation to empower young people to question stories they've heard and step into their own creative power.

October 23, 2026, at 4:30pm

Professional Learning Lab: Taking Up Space

Drawing on a range of physical theater traditions, you'll dive into how weight, effort, stillness and gesture can convey an entire narrative.

January 8, 2027, at 4:30pm

Professional Learning Lab: There Are No Words

You'll devise dynamic, wordless scenes and discover how the absence of spoken language can be an invitation to richer and more inclusive storytelling.

February 5, 2027, at 4:30pm

More Ways to Get Tickets

Groups

Whether a birthday celebration, scout trip or just a regular day of fun, create a memorable theatergoing experience for your family and friends!

Birthday Celebrations

Looking for unique and affordable birthday party ideas? Celebrate with a one-of-a-kind experience that's bound to entertain at the New Victory!

Gift Cards

With the flexibility to add any dollar amount and no expiration date, a New Victory gift card is a perfect present for your friends or family.

New 42 powers two distinctive signature projects. The New Victory Theater is dedicated to arts programming for youth and educators, offering enriching experiences and valuable resources. Similarly, New 42 Studios provides essential space rentals to support artists and foster new ideas in the arts.
